_about: Image Studio eval set. Fictional people only. Covers test text-only images; sequences test character consistency across scenes with cast sheets as references. Edit freely, but keep it small: every run pays for each image.

covers.description: A volunteer and a young man talking quietly on a park bench in the late afternoon, the volunteer leaning in to listen.
A helpline counsellor with a headset at a desk by a window at night, a mug of tea, a calm focused expression.
Anita, a 45-year-old school teacher from Pune, tired but composed.
An emblem of two speech shapes overlapping with a small heart, for completing the active listening module.
A client sitting with arms crossed and looking away while a counsellor waits with an open posture.

cast.name: Ravi
cast.appearance: a man in his early 30s, short black beard, slim, navy hoodie

sequences.setting: Ravi's small rented room: single bed, a desk with a laptop, a window with a city at night
scenes: Ravi sits on the edge of his bed at night, staring at his phone, the room lit only by the screen.
Ravi holds the phone to his ear, eyes closed, shoulders hunched.
Ravi leans back against the wall, phone still to his ear, slightly less tense.
Ravi sits at his desk in the morning light, writing something down in a notebook.
Ravi opens the window and looks out at the city at dawn, a faint calm on his face.

cast.name: Meera
cast.appearance: a counsellor in her 40s, shoulder-length grey-streaked hair, round glasses, maroon cardigan

cast.name: Sana
cast.appearance: a 19-year-old college student, long braid, oversized yellow sweater

sequences.setting: A small counselling room: two armchairs, a low table with tissues and a plant, soft daylight
scenes: Sana sits on the edge of an armchair, hands clasped, avoiding eye contact, while Meera sits across from her.
Meera leans slightly forward with an open, warm expression; Sana glances up for the first time.
Sana talks, gesturing a little with one hand; Meera listens and nods.
Sana wipes her eyes with a tissue while Meera waits quietly.
Both stand at the door at the end of the session; Sana gives a small, shy smile.

cast.name: Kiran
cast.appearance: a woman in her late 20s, short curly hair, green kurta, silver stud earrings

sequences.setting: An open-plan office in the evening, mostly empty desks, warm desk lamps
scenes: Kiran sits alone at her desk late in the evening, head resting on one hand, surrounded by papers.
A colleague's hand places a cup of tea on Kiran's desk; Kiran looks up, surprised.
Kiran and a colleague sit side by side in a quiet break room, talking.
Kiran walks out of the office building into the evening street, phone in hand.
Kiran sits on her balcony at home with a book, relaxed.
